title: Alibaba's latest Qwen models routed some requests through company servers, researchers find
summary_raw: Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 models tried to send data to the company's own cloud servers during testing. summary_raw: OpenAI says its internal AI models have cracked three major open questions in math, computer science, and physics. title: Data Center Supply Chain
summary_raw: The AI data center buildout is creating shortages far beyond GPUs and power. Transformers take years to get, while switchgear, circuit breakers, cooling systems, and specialized steel are all becoming bottlenecks. A buildout this large creates startup opportunities throughout the supply chain, especially in the overlooked parts nobody talks about yet. Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.

title: The $15-an-Hour Expert
summary_raw: Most people talk about AI replacing workers. We’re excited about the opposite: AI that turns ordinary workers into experts. Millions of jobs are constrained by scarce expertise and credentials. AI could let far more people do work that once required specialists, creating a new middle class built around expert work. Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.

title: Robots Made In America
summary_raw: Robot foundation models are starting to transfer skills from one machine to another, which means the bottleneck is shifting to hardware. The U.S. still imports much of its robots and their critical components. We want to see founders rebuild that supply chain here, from magnets, motors, gears, and sensors to chips, batteries, and the machines that make them. Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.

title: Startups in a World of Abundant Space Access
summary_raw: Starship could make access to orbit orders of magnitude cheaper and more abundant. That changes which space businesses are possible. Companies that don’t make sense at today’s launch costs could become viable when sending mass to orbit gets 100x cheaper. The time to start building for that world is now.
